channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Khaman Maluach | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Khaman Maluach from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jordan Ott on Khaman Maluach, Oso Ighodaro
item.description:
Duane Rankin:Jordan Ott on Suns bigs Oso Ighodaro and Khaman Maluach as Ighodaro will start tonight vs. Pistons:

“Remember they're young players, but all these possessions are valuable to us as we evaluate during the preseason into regular season, we need both of them.”

Jordan Ott on Khaman Maluach, Oso Ighodaro, Oct 5, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Grayson Allen on Khaman Maluach
item.description:
Grayson Allen on Suns rookie 7-footer Khaman Maluach talking on defense:

“He talks nonstop on the court. Like he's commanding the defense, calling out coverages, constantly talking. For a rookie, let alone a 19-year-old guy to come into a gym and do that first day of training camp is impressive. He's already ready in that aspect.”

Grayson Allen on Khaman Maluach, Sep 27, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Rich Paul on Khaman Maluach
item.description:
A video has just surfaced of Paul on the phone talking to owner Mat Ishbia about getting Maluach to the Suns.

“If you guys keep 10, I’m going to mention a name, and you tell me how much you like him. Khaman Maluach,”

Rich Paul on Khaman Maluach, Jun 30, 2025. Source: reddit.
